comment_changes.before:
/** * Port of GT6's {@code WorldgenBushes} ({@code Loader_Worldgen:633}). * *

GT6 plants one bush per chunk with a {@code 1/4} roll in plains and woods (never in frozen * biomes), picks the berry type with its value noise at {@code (x/2, 300, z/2)} modulo the number of * berry types, and then spreads the same bush to up to four horizontal neighbours (and attached * branches on each core). * *

The port keeps GT6's noise: {@code gregtech.worldgen.GTCellNoise} is a port of GT6's * {@code NoiseGenerator} including its 256-cell offset table, so the same coordinates give the same * berry type. */
comment_changes.after:
/** * Port of GT6's {@code WorldgenBushes} ({@code Loader_Worldgen:633}). * *

The current feature attempts one column per chunk with a {@code 1/4} roll, checks its biome * allowlist and surface, then places a ripe core, optional horizontal cores and attached branches. * *

{@code GTCellNoise} retains the original cell algorithm and offset table. This caller uses * floating-point half-coordinates, while GT6 used integer division; identical world coordinates * therefore do not guarantee the same selection. Biome and surface policies are audited separately. */

noise_derivation.kind: Limited source-based arithmetic derivation, not a production test fixture or world simulation
noise_derivation.semantics: Round each Java float operation through IEEE-754 binary32 using struct; signed 32-bit overflow for hash/cubic products; Java integer /2 truncates toward zero before float argument conversion; Math.round simulated as floor(v+0.5), including the exact positive y=22.5 tie rounded to23 (no negative half-tie input); all compared nearest-cell distances are unequal.
noise_derivation.ordering_independent_proof: x340 and x341 at z128 have identical original integer arguments and therefore the same original map key for any fixed HashMap traversal order. Current indices differ 8 versus 2; its list contains distinct raspberry versus candleberry. No permutation of a fixed original nine-entry pool can make both positions match. This does not assert seed0 actual terrain/selected offsets or global frequency statistics.

base_pool.reason: ItemStackMap extends HashMap, not insertion-ordered LinkedHashMap; old runtime item numeric identities are not re-created. Optional external additions and Harvestcraft cotton replacement are conditional.

scope_limits: Default bush strength is 0/0 after instabreak; original effective resistance is the .2 override, not the .3 registration input.
Default fire object-map values are zero; external fire registrations and actual weather/game-rule behavior were not run.
Core inWall difference requires an eligible non-noPhysics entity eye volume embedded in the core. Normal walking is not thorn damage.
No-cover collision and lightBlock 1/0 already correspond. Cover geometry, placement eligibility and full physics remain separate.
Noise witnesses are finite source arithmetic, not a generated seed-0 world. Original HashMap order is unknown; adjacent-equality counterexample does not depend on it.
Suspended-log column and biome gates are conditional source examples. Modern biome names and vertical scan range require adaptation decisions, not automatic restoration.
No Gradle, Java compilation, new production tests, game, world generation, actual save/restart, build, push or gameplay changes in this batch.
